name: flaggems_max_unpool3d
description: Extracted from FlagGems max_unpool3d. Computes a partial inverse of MaxPool3d: scatters the pooled input values back to the positions recorded in indices (from torch.nn.MaxPool3d(kernel_size=2, stride=2, return_indices=True)), filling the rest with zeros. Inputs (pooled tensor + indices) are correlated and constructed by pooling a random tensor, so a custom generator reproduces them. Reference uses the vendor torch.nn.functional.max_unpool3d baseline.
reference:
import torch


def gen_inputs(ctx, device):
    shape = ctx["input__shape"]
    raw_dtype = ctx["input__dtype"]
    dtype = getattr(torch, raw_dtype) if isinstance(raw_dtype, str) else raw_dtype
    x = torch.randn(shape, dtype=dtype, device=device)
    pool = torch.nn.MaxPool3d(kernel_size=2, stride=2, return_indices=True)
    output, indices = pool(x)
    return {"input": output, "indices": indices}


def run(input, indices, kernel_size, stride, padding, output_size):
    return torch.nn.functional.max_unpool3d(
        input,
        indices,
        kernel_size=kernel_size,
        stride=stride,
        padding=padding,
        output_size=output_size,
    )
